sprint: World-Owned Text Style — Bold Toggle; Context Panel Welcome Heading Removed
task: Two small, related fixes to the World-owned Text quick-edit popup and the Context Panel's default view. (1) 'weight is a very technical term, is that drop down even needed?' -> a wireframed proposal -> 'approved make the change.' The old 7-option Weight dropdown (World Default/Light/Regular/Medium/Semibold/Bold/Black) is retired outright; Font Family now spans its own row alone, and Bold joins the Style row as a fourth toggle alongside Italic/Underline/Strikethrough, writing the identical fontWeight field ('700' on, cleared off) through the same SceneEngine.setContentOverride path the dropdown always used -- a narrower vocabulary a Story Author actually reasons about, not a new mechanism. (2) A screenshot showing 'Welcome to [broken image glyph] Forest Sync - cloud 1.2.' prompted an investigation into a glyph-rendering mismatch (Studio vs. Builder) that was ultimately superseded by direct clarification: 'what i meant is that welcome string in the right pane of studio is not needed . we can remove it.' The heading and its _worldIdentity() lookup are removed entirely from the Context Panel's default view; the rest of the panel (ownership legend, Personalize zone, Add Something) is untouched. Verified via two new Playwright suites (bold_toggle_verify.js, 22/22; welcome_heading_removed_verify.js, 4/4) plus full regression across the existing popup-layout/real-content/text-object-build suites, all unchanged. Both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2) pass unchanged -- both changes are confined entirely to root Studio. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder architecture change; confined to js/contextPanel.js and css/style.css.
